title: H2DF: Calibrated Target Bands for Controllable Language-Model Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2610.26864v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gradient ascent (GA) is a simple language-model unlearning baseline, but it continues increasing forget loss after useful forgetting has occurred. This unbounded pressure can damage retained utility and make forgotten examples abnormally high-loss. We introduce H2DF, a calibrated target-band objective that applies GA-like pressure below a data-dependent lower target and suppresses, or reverses, that pressure after the target region is reached. The targets are estimated from matched non-member examples before training, so the base objective requires one forget-batch forward/backward pass per optimization step; our reported TOFU variant adds sparse retain replay every tenth step. We instantiate a one-sided objective for TOFU question answering and a two-sided objective for MUSE-News language modeling. Across three TOFU seeds, H2DF obtains a forget NLL of 1.528 with margin 0.049 and retain NLL of 1.165 with margin 0.047, matching GradDiff

translated_title: H2DF：用于可控语言模型遗忘的校准目标区间
translated_abstract: 梯度上升（GA）是一种简单的语言模型遗忘基线方法，但在有用的遗忘已经发生后，它仍会持续增加遗忘损失。这种无界的压力会损害保留数据的效用，并使被遗忘的样本出现异常高的损失。我们提出了H2DF，一种校准的目标区间目标函数，它在低于数据相关的下目标时施加类似GA的压力，并在达到目标区域后抑制或反转该压力。这些目标是在训练前从匹配的非成员样本中估计得到的，因此基础目标函数在每个优化步骤中仅需一次遗忘批次的前向/反向传播；我们报告的TOFU变体每十步增加一次稀疏的保留数据回放。我们为TOFU问答任务实例化了一个单侧目标，为MUSE-News语言建模任务实例化了一个双侧目标。在三个TOFU随机种子上，H2DF取得了遗忘NLL为1.528（裕度0.049）、保留NLL为1.165（裕度0.047）的结果，与GradDiff相当。
tldr: H2DF提出了一种校准的目标区间目标函数，通过数据依赖的目标带控制梯度上升压力，在遗忘达到目标后自动抑制或反转压力，从而实现可控的语言模型遗忘，同时保护保留数据的效用。
en_tdlr: H2DF introduces a calibrated target-band objective that applies gradient-ascent pressure only below a data-dependent target and suppresses or reverses it once the target region is reached, enabling controllable language-model unlearning while preserving retained utility.
